title: feat(automation)!: an after-save flow is not armed while a subflow it calls retries an inline call, and a durable http node with no outbox does not hold the save
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMscMg6AKHasj3ZXEDorLPH)_

Fixes #32526

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — taught in `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (Try / catch / retry) and in `os explain flow-after-save-inline-retry`; no skill under `skills/**` teaches the subflow or the no-outbox case.

> **BREAKING** (ADR-0087 `not-required`): a flow that runs after a record change is registered but **not armed** while a `subflow` / `map` child it calls retries an inline outbound call (new `unboundCause: retried_callout_in_subflow`); and on a host with no messaging HTTP outbox, a durable `http` node on the save path is sent once in the background instead of inline. First-party count: 0 flows of that shape in `examples/**`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保存后运行的流程（record-after-*）如果通过子流程 / map 调用到「会被重试的内联外呼」（不带 durable 的 http，或 connector_action），现在注册但不挂上触发器，`/automation/_status` 显示 `bound: false`、原因 `retried_callout_in_subflow`，Studio 也有一句中文/英文说明；子流程改好后自动重新挂上。另外，没有配消息发件箱的部署里，保存路径上 `durable: true` 的 http 节点改为后台发一次、不等结果、不重试。
- 为什么改：裁决 D「保存记录永不等外部系统」。#32515 只拦了流程自己图里的重试，子流程里的重试和「durable 但没发件箱」两种情况仍会让用户保存卡住好几秒（重试阶梯）。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（BREAKING，minor）。之前能挂上的这类流程现在不挂，但仍注册、仍能手动运行；第一方示例 0 处。没发件箱时后台发送失败只记 error 日志、不重试（和发件箱的语义一致，流程本来就不等结果）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/subflow-retry-guard.ts`（判定）、`engine.ts` 的 `declineOntoSubflowRetriedCallout`、`builtin/http-nodes.ts` 的 `onSavePath` 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/subflow-region-suspension.test.ts src/builtin/http-nodes.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中新加的 retried_callout_in_subflow 与 "durable http with no outbox on the save path" 两组通过。
- 需要你做的：无，复审 PASS 后由 A5 落地。

## What changes

**1. Subflow callee (arming gate, fourth half).** `activateFlowTrigger` already declines a caller onto a disabled subflow, a save notice after a suspending subflow, and a region-nested call to a suspending child. It now also declines a flow whose start node runs it after a record change when a `subflow` / `map` node of it (top-level or in any region) reaches an inline outbound call (`http` without `durable: true`, or `connector_action`) that something on the call chain retries: the child's own `try_catch` retry or whole-run retry, a deeper child's, or a retry around the call in the caller. The reading is `subflowRetriedCallout` (new `subflow-retry-guard.ts`), and it walks with the same retry walk the after-save judge uses (`walkRetriedNodes`, factored out of `validateAfterSaveInlineRetry` unchanged in behaviour), so the two never disagree on what a retry is.
- A decline, never a refusal, as the other halves: the child may register after the caller, so registration cannot judge it without depending on load order. The flow registers, is not armed, warns once, and `/_status` reports `bound: false` with the reason and `unboundCause: retried_callout_in_subflow` (added to `FLOW_UNBOUND_CAUSES` in `@objectstack/spec/contracts`; the Studio run note has a plain-words line in en and zh).
- `rejudgeSubflowCallers` asks this half again for every flow whose calls reach a changed flow, so a child republished with the call durable re-arms the caller.

**2. Durable `http` with no outbox (run time).** The outbox cannot be judged at arm time: messaging wires it at `kernel:ready`, after flows arm, so an arm-time verdict would be recorded against a registry still filling. So the fallback changes instead, on the save path only (the record-change after-phase events, which a `subflow` / `map` child inherits through its context): the request is sent once in the background, the node answers `{ enqueued: false, background: true }` with `unmeasuredEffect`, and the run neither waits nor sees the outcome, which is what `durable: true` means with an outbox. A failed send is logged at `error` (consequence + fix) and is not retried. Off the save path the inline fallback is unchanged.

**Text.** The `http` fix sentence (engine refusal, lint rule `flow-after-save-inline-retry` and `os explain`) and `flows.mdx` now say what the no-outbox case does, and the lint explanation no longer says a callee "is judged on its own trigger".

## Tests

- `subflow-region-suspension.test.ts` (the arming gate's shared harness), new top-level describe: declined for each retry position (child `try_catch`, child whole-run retry, caller `try_catch` around the call, caller whole-run retry with a `map` call), reading through a grandchild, re-judge (armed with no child → disarmed → re-armed when the child's call is durable), and three controls that arm (retried durable call, unretried inline call, a before-save caller).
- `builtin/http-nodes.test.ts`, new top-level describe: on `afterInsert` / `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` a `try_catch`-retried durable node with no outbox lets the run complete while the request is still in flight, sends once, and logs the lost failure at `error`; CONTROL `beforeUpdate` keeps the inline fallback and its four attempts.
- Ablations (one-shot, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): gate call removed → 6 of the new gate tests red; `onSavePath` branch disabled → the 3 save-path tests red (the run waits on the in-flight request).

## Acceptance notes

- `os lint` / `os validate` still judge only a flow's own graph for `flow-after-save-inline-retry`; they could read callees statically (the stack holds all flows), but `packages/lint` is the spec lane's and the engine gate covers the runtime. Noted, not filed.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` follows the precedent of the region half (a flow armed before is not armed now); `Metadata-protocol: semantic` for the changed meaning of `durable: true` on a host with no outbox.

## Verification

Local (head 2b9a28a89): `@objectstack/service-automation` test 280/280 files, 3861/3861 tests; typecheck exit 0; `@objectstack/lint` lint-flow-patterns + rule-explanations 285/285; spec `automation-service.test.ts` 20/20; spec build + `check:generated` all 14 artifacts up to date.

`dispatch-gates --commands` derived set: 123 commands, 117 exit 0. The other 6 measured nothing locally (environment, not findings): `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` timed out waiting for the shared verify lock (exit 3/99); `spec check:skill-examples` refused on an unbuilt `@objectstack/client-react` (exit 3, "nothing was measured"); `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs a full clone (exit 3); `ui vitest run scripts/` failed only on `unit-registry-absence-collision` because `@objectstack/client` has no local build ("Failed to resolve entry"), a file this PR does not touch. CI measures all of them on the head.

CI on head `2b9a28a8`: 59 check runs success, 9 skipped, 0 failed.
